pagedata.pyDescription: Performs a flow action on a work object. The users access group information is used to validate access to the flow and flow action before performing any work.
pagedata.pyUsage: Use this activity to run a flow action. Call it with a primary page that inherits from work- and is populated with all the required data. Prior to calling this routine the caller must create the primary page by acquiring (locking) the work object and populate it with any data that is needed to perform the action.

Use this method only when necessary. If executing Java code is required, consider using the Call-Function activity method to execute a Function rule. Using Function rules encourages creating well-defined input and output parameters and can be reused across many different types of rules.

Use of an internal activity from another ruleset is not recommended. The calling signature of these rules may change over time, or they may be deprecated completely. Consider using non-internal activities instead.
The use of activity rules should be limited. The need for activities can be reduced by using data transforms, as well as techniques such as case management, the Engine API, and declaratives.
